title: Vueform scraped locales
description: Available locales keyed by locale code (.generated/<source>/locales.json). Each entry's key prop repeats its object key.

key.description: The locale code, same as the object key.

name.description: The locale's display name in its own language (docblock @name).

loc.description: Repo-relative `path:line` of the locale file's docblock (anchored at line 1).
